plan.title: Prevent deleting the only product row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type from the default RFP to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create flow.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the specified CYLINDER product as the only line item.
Set the only row's requested quantity to 10.
Choose the specified delivery location for the only row.
Verify the product's variant auto-fills as Variant 1.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, hover the only product row, click its bin/delete control, and stop when the screen shows the refusal that at least one product is required and the last row cannot be removed.

steps.note: Perform the exact row-level deletion interaction requested by the case.

args.text: At least one product is required, so the last one can't be removed.

steps.note: Assert the expected refusal message is visible.
